title: EgoOmniWorld: Unifying Egocentric Understanding via Ego-Action-World Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2610.18499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Egocentric video understanding spans diverse capabilities, modalities, and evaluation formats, yet these are often studied in isolation despite their tight coupling in real-world interaction. We propose the Ego-Action-World interaction loop as a unifying principle: the wearer perceives the world, forms goals, acts, changes the world, and uses feedback to guide subsequent behavior. Based on this view, we introduce EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark organized around four complementary interaction structures: Node captures ego, action, and world states; Edge captures directed relations among them; Chain captures linked dependencies; and Loop captures feedback-closed interactions. We develop an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline that extracts structured interactions from egocentric videos, grounds them in visual and auditory evidence, and generates questions according to their interaction structure. translated_title: EgoOmniWorld：通过自我-动作-世界交互统一第一人称视角理解
translated_abstract: 第一人称视角视频理解涵盖多种能力、模态和评估格式，尽管它们在真实世界交互中紧密耦合，但通常被孤立地研究。我们提出“自我-动作-世界”交互循环作为统一原则：佩戴者感知世界、形成目标、采取行动、改变世界，并利用反馈来指导后续行为。基于这一观点，我们提出了EgoOmniWorld，一个围绕四种互补交互结构组织的基准测试：节点捕捉自我、动作和世界状态；边捕捉它们之间的有向关系；链捕捉链接的依赖关系；环捕捉反馈闭环交互。我们开发了一个以交互为先、以证据为依据的数据流水线，从第一人称视频中提取结构化交互，将其锚定于视觉和听觉证据之上，并根据其交互结构生成问题。
tldr: 本文提出EgoOmniWorld基准，以“自我-动作-世界”交互循环为统一原则，通过节点、边、链、环四种互补交互结构以及以交互为先、以证据为依据的数据流水线，全面评估第一人称视频理解能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces EgoOmniWorld, a benchmark that unifies egocentric video understanding through an Ego-Action-World interaction loop, organized around four complementary interaction structures (Node, Edge, Chain, and Loop) with an interaction-first, evidence-grounded data pipeline.
